# Mister Horse

> > Mister Horse creates professional plugins and presets for Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro, including Animation Composer, Premiere Composer, and extensive motion graphics libraries.

Mister Horse specializes in time-saving tools for video editors and motion designers, offering thousands of animation presets, transitions, titles, and special effects. Their flagship products include Animation Composer for After Effects and Premiere Composer for Premiere Pro, along with specialized packs like Hand Drawn Stuff, Essential Typography, and 3D Titles.

## Key Topics

- Animation Composer
- Premiere Composer
- Motion graphics presets
- Hand Drawn Stuff
- Essential Typography
- 3D Titles
- Shape Elements
- 2D Special Effects
- Animated Fonts
- Text Presets
- Timers & Counters
- Cinematic Titles
- Transitions
- Overlays
- Video editing plugins

- [Mister Horse Homepage](https://misterhorse.com): Homepage for Mister Horse's After Effects & Premiere Pro plugin tools
- [Products for After Effects](https://misterhorse.com/products-for-after-effects): After Effects products catalog: Animation Composer & motion graphics
- [Products for Premiere Pro](https://misterhorse.com/products-for-premiere-pro): Premiere Pro plugins catalog: Premiere Composer, transitions, overlays
